component.name: Kinefin
component.summary: Browse Jellyfin movies and TV series on KDE Plasma

description.p: Kinefin is a native KDE Plasma client for browsing movie and TV libraries on Jellyfin servers. It uses Kirigami and a direct Jellyfin API connection instead of embedding a browser.
Organize and explore your media with familiar desktop controls:

ul.li: Browse films, series, seasons and episodes with library filters and search
Switch between saved users and servers, and manage favorites
Review items, playback queues and remote playback sessions

description.p: Kinefin is an independent client and requires access to a Jellyfin server.
